extra.reason: SHIPPED on worktree agent-readback (commit 91ad97d): Mob.Scene3d.Test.Physics.assert_scene_tracks_physics/3 + MismatchError. Physics-engine-agnostic - takes {entity_id, {x,y,z}, {qx,qy,qz,qw}} shape that RapierLab.Physics.transforms/1 already returns. Handles quat sign ambiguity, list-shaped JSON readback, custom tolerance, phantom-body noting. 9 new tests, full suite 164/164.

project/N landed as an Elixir-side computation off scene()'s existing world_transform readback — same authoritative Filament TransformManager source the render thread uses, no new NIF surface, one-file diff.

Matrix math split into Mob.Scene3d.Projection (perspective/4, inverse/1, mul_vec/2, ndc_to_pixel/3, project_entity/6) so the hot pieces are testable as pure functions. Facade in Mob.Scene3d.project/N mirrors pick's overload pattern (host/device shapes, default viewport).

viewport_size arrives as {w, h} in dp/pt from the caller — the same values the screen declared with Mob.Scene3d.viewport(...). A future NIF revision that reads _view->getViewport() natively can drop that argument; the facade shape stays the same either way. Noted the design tradeoff in the docstring + CHANGELOG so a follow-up bead can push project() to the render thread if animated scenes that mutate transforms outside the IR flow ever need real-time authoritative answers.

Guide entry (guides/agents.md) writes up the pick + project + sample_region readback triple with a runnable example. Registered in ex_doc's :extras.

Host tests: 18 new (scene3d_projection_test.exs — pure math; scene3d_project_test.exs — facade with a mocked Native impl, error paths for missing entity / camera / bad scene). Full mob_scene3d suite 173/173.

Moto G verify (through rapier_lab, which path-deps mob_scene3d):
  - camera projects to (186, 250) = viewport center — expected (camera-through-its-own-view = origin at NDC 0,0)
  - ground origin projects to (186, 411) — center-x, lower half; camera pitched down at -40° from y=0.9 looks down at the floor, so the origin lands below the horizon line. Matches the mental picture.
  - shell_4 (still inside arena, at world (-0.088, 0.010, -0.292)) projects to (162, 302) — slightly left of centre, below the horizon. Matches world position.
  - project → sample_region(x - 16, y - 16, 32, 32) → dominant colour readback closes the triple end-to-end.
  - Error paths honest: {:error, {:no_entity, id}} for a missing entity id.

Follow-ups surfaced:
  - Native-authoritative variant (single-tick NIF that reads TransformManager on the render thread instead of via scene readback). File a bd when a real animated scene needs it.
  - rapier_lab arena leak: 6 of 7 shells escaped the arena walls (positions 1+ metres from origin, arena_half=0.20). Not a mob_scene3d issue but flagged for the shells demo — probably wall thickness/damping.
  - Scaled cameras: general 4x4 inverse handles them, but face-camera scenes should stay rigid. No known caller uses a scaled camera.
